decision: Not adopted: removing the call alone does not resolve the dominant coincident-event deviation, and no stable end-to-end performance benefit is established.
limitations: One timing sample for this experimental binary; no claim of statistical equality or regression.
Build metadata differs, so the 132-byte text difference is not solely attributable to inlining.
This does not exclude a small contribution from call overhead.
No production firmware behavior was changed; original precision diagnostic remains failing.
